agents.name: Bob
memories: Water is the constraint that ends farms.
Do not plant more than we can water.

today.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms. The sprout is growing under clear sky — keep the ditch-fed moisture high so the ear finishes before any dry day can steal it.
today.expect: East field still soaked so tomorrow's grow step lands on ripe without a moisture scare.

yesterday.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms. Harvest filled the bin, but the cistern is what keeps a clear-sky sprout alive — top it before any dry streak can write the ending.
yesterday.expect: Cistern fatter so tomorrow's drip and any irrigate never threaten the new row.

agents.name: Alice
memories: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve.
Ditches compound. Heat does not wait.

today.why: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve — but the row is already growing. Heat does not wait, and neither does a thin woodpile while we wait on the ear.
today.expect: Two more sticks in storage while the crop finishes under the ditch.

yesterday.why: Ditches compound. Heat does not wait. The seed just went in — push moisture onto the sprout while the ditch still multiplies every pour.
yesterday.expect: East field moisture near the top so the sprout advances under clear sky.
